1.en: Glorify the Name of your Lord that is exalt your Lord above what does not befit Him ism in isma rabbika ‘the Name of your Lord’ is extra the Most High an adjective qualifying rabbika ‘your Lord’
1.ar: ﴿سَبِّحْ اِسْم رَبّك﴾ أيْ نَزِّهْ رَبّك عَمّا لا يَلِيق بِهِ واسْم زائِد ﴿الأَعْلى﴾ صِفَة لِرَبِّك

2.en: Who created and proportioned His creature making it of well-proportioned parts without irregularities
2.ar: ﴿الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوّى﴾ مَخْلُوقه، جَعَلَهُ مُتَناسِب الأَجْزاء غَيْر مُتَفاوِت

3.en: and Who determined what He wants and guided to what He had determined of good or evil
3.ar: ﴿والَّذِي قَدَّرَ﴾ ما شاءَ ﴿فَهَدى﴾ إلى ما قَدَّرَهُ مِن خَيْر وشَرّ

4.en: and Who brought forth the pasture Who caused herbage to grow

5.en: then made it after verdancy blackened stubble desiccated broken chaff.
5.ar: ﴿فَجَعَلَهُ﴾ بَعْد الخُضْرَة ﴿غُثاء﴾ جافًّا هَشِيمًا ﴿أحَوى﴾ أسْوَد يابِسًا

6.en: We will have you recite the Qur’ān so that you will not forget what you recite

7.en: except what God may will that you forget by abrogating its recitation and its ruling — the Prophet s used to recite aloud while Gabriel recited fearing to forget and so it is as though it was said to him ‘Do not hasten in it; you will not forget and so do not weary yourself by reciting it aloud’; assuredly He exalted be He knows what is overt of words and deeds and what is hidden of both of these.
7.ar: ﴿إلّا ما شاءَ اللَّه﴾ أنْ تَنْساهُ بِنَسْخِ تِلاوَته وحُكْمه، وكانَ ﷺ يَجْهَر بِالقِراءَةِ مَعَ قِراءَة جِبْرِيل خَوْف النِّسْيان فَكَأَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ: لا تَعْجَل بِها إنَّك لا تَنْسى فَلا تُتْعِب نَفْسك بِالجَهْرِ بِها ﴿إنَّهُ﴾ تَعالى ﴿يَعْلَم الجَهْر﴾ مِن القَوْل والفِعْل ﴿وما يَخْفى﴾ مِنهُما

8.en: And We will ease your way to the easy way the uncomplicated Law namely Islam.

9.en: So remind admonish by the Qur’ān in case the reminder should be of benefit to the one whom you might remind the one mentioned in the following verse ‘he who fears will be reminded’ in other words even if it might not be of benefit for it is of benefit to some but of no benefit to others.
9.ar: ﴿فَذَكِّرْ﴾ عِظْ بِالقُرْآنِ ﴿إنْ نَفَعَتْ الذِّكْرى﴾ مِن تَذْكِرَة المَذْكُور فِي سَيَذَّكَّرُ، يَعْنِي وإنْ لَمْ تَنْفَع ونَفْعها لِبَعْضٍ وعَدَم النَّفْع لِبَعْضٍ آخَر

10.en: He who fears God exalted be He will be reminded by it as in the verse So admonish by the Qur’ān him who fears My threat Q. 5045;
10.ar: ﴿سَيَذَّكَّرُ﴾ بِها ﴿مَن يَخْشى﴾ يَخاف اللَّه تَعالى كَآيَةِ

11.en: but the wretched one al-ashqā means al-shaqī that is to say the disbeliever will shun it that is the reminder in other words he will leave it aside not looking at it
11.ar: ﴿ويَتَجَنَّبها﴾ أيْ الذِّكْرى، أيْ يَتْرُكها جانِبًا لا يَلْتَفِت إلَيْها ﴿الأَشْقى﴾ بِمَعْنى الشَّقِيّ أيْ الكافِر

12.en: he who will be roasted in the greater Fire the Fire of the Hereafter the lesser fire being that of this world;
12.ar: ﴿الَّذِي يَصْلى النّار الكُبْرى﴾ هِيَ نار الآخِرَة والصُّغْرى نار الدُّنْيا

13.en: then he will neither die therein and find rest nor live a enjoyable life.
13.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ لا يَمُوت فِيها﴾ فَيَسْتَرِيح ﴿ولا يَحْيا﴾ حَياة هَنِيئَة

14.en: Successful winner indeed is he who purifies himself who cleanses himself by means of his adherence to faith

15.en: and mentions the Name of his Lord saying Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’ and prays the five prayers — and such are the concerns of one working towards the Hereafter concerns which the Meccan disbelievers shun.
15.ar: ﴿وذَكَرَ اِسْم رَبّه﴾ مُكَبِّرًا ﴿فَصَلّى﴾ الصَّلَوات الخَمْس وذَلِكَ مِن أُمُور الآخِرَة وكَفّار مَكَّة مُعْرِضُونَ عَنْها

16.en: Nay but you prefer or read yu’thirūna ‘they prefer’ the life of this world to the Hereafter
16.ar: ﴿بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ﴾ بِالفَوْقانِيَّةِ والتَّحْتانِيَّة ﴿الحَياة الدُّنْيا﴾ عَلى الآخِرَة

17.en: whereas the Hereafter and the Paradise it entails is better and more lasting.

18.en: Truly this the success of those who purify themselves and the Hereafter being better is in the former scrolls the ones revealed before the Qur’ān
18.ar: ﴿إنَّ هَذا﴾ إفْلاح مَن تَزَكّى وكَوْن الآخِرَة خَبَرًا ﴿لَفِي الصُّحُف الأُولى﴾ أيْ المُنَزَّلَة قَبْل القُرْآن

19.en: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses the ten scrolls of Abraham and the Torah of Moses.
19.ar: ﴿صُحُف إبْراهِيم ومُوسى﴾ وهِيَ عَشْر صُحُف لِإبْراهِيم والتَّوْراة لِمُوسى.
